name: im-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Isle of Man tax system for 2026/27 (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027): the authorities (Income Tax Division; Customs and Immigration), the tax year and currency, residence, the GBP 17,000 personal allowance, the 10% and 21% rates and the 21% non-resident rate, the GBP 220,000 tax cap, the 0%, 10% and 20% company rates and the 15% Domestic Top-up Tax, National Insurance rates, VAT at 20% with the GBP 90,000 threshold and the Island's own 5% rates, no capital gains tax or inheritance tax, and the main return and payment dates. Trigger phrases: Isle of Man tax overview, how does tax work in the Isle of Man, Manx tax rates 2026, IOM 0% company tax, Isle of Man tax cap. For detail use the domain skills: im-income-tax, im-non-resident-income-tax, im-corporate-income-tax, im-payroll-social, isle-of-man-vat, im-related-party-uk-treaty, im-company-formation.
